title: 수산업ㆍ어촌 발전 기본법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:2:00006:part:1/1

Article 4-2 (Selection of New Fisheries Knowledge Persons, etc.)
(1) A new fisheries knowledge person under Article 17-2 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a "new fisheries knowledge person") shall be selected by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries from among any of the following persons:
1. Fishers;
2. Other persons engaged in business related to fisheries who are prescribed and publicly notified by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries.
(2) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may provide education, training, information, etc. necessary for fostering new fisheries knowledge persons.
(3) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may provide administrative and financial support necessary to promote the activities of new fisheries knowledge persons.
(4) Detailed matters necessary for the selection, fostering, and support of new fisheries knowledge persons, other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) through (3), shall be prescribed and publicly notified by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries.
